products.descriptionEs: Papas crujientes rellenas de queso cheddar derretido, tocino ahumado y cebollines frescos.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy potato skins filled with melted cheddar cheese, smoked bacon, and fresh chives.

products.descriptionEs: Carne de res Angus de 8oz, lechuga, tomate, cebolla roja y queso americano en pan brioche.
products.descriptionEn: 8oz Angus beef patty, lettuce, tomato, red onion, and American cheese on a toasted brioche bun.

products.nameEs: Salmón a la Parrilla con Hierbas
products.descriptionEs: Filete de salmón fresco marinado en hierbas finas, servido con espárragos y puré de papas.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh salmon fillet marinated in fine herbs, served with grilled asparagus and creamy mashed potatoes.

products.descriptionEs: Limonada refrescante hecha con limones frescos y puré de frambuesa natural.
products.descriptionEn: Refreshing lemonade made with fresh-squeezed lemons and natural raspberry puree.
